educationalGoal:
Students will learn the fundamental mathematics necessary for engineers:
(1) exponential functions, and logarithmic functions and their graphs.
(2) trigonometric ratios, and trigonometric functions and their graphs.
(3) differential coefficients and derivatives of polynomials.
(4) indefinite and definite integrals of polynomials.
(5) graph drawing using Excel.
advice:
This is a basic course in mathematics for information science.
We will cover the following topics:
1. Exponential and logarithmic laws, their functions and their graphs.
2. Trigonometric ratios, trigonometric functions and their graphs.
3. Differential coefficients and differentiation of polynomials.
4. Indefinite and definite integrals of polynomials.
5. Graph drawing of functions using Excel.
Students are required to do daily self-study (preparation, review) and, in particular, after class, to solve
the textbook problems and understand them thoroughly.
Students are strictly prohibited from copying the answers of others. If there are any questions, students
should use the Center for Mathematics and Science in Education and Research.
Students are expected to demonstrate their answers logically and write sentences and mathematical formulas
carefully. Students must keep to the homework submission deadline according to the instructions of the
teacher in charge.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the
teacher.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand exponential and logarithmic laws, calculations, functions and draw their graphs.
Be able to understand trigonometric ratios, the properties of trigonometric functions and draw their graphs.
Be able to understand the concepts of calculus, and find the derivatives and the indefinite integrals,etc.
Be able to draw quadratic, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, etc., graphs using Excel.
Be able to understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Be able to understand the contents of the class by completing the exercises and homework, and attending classes.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)  Understand the exponential and logarithmic laws and draw graphs of their functions correctly by translation.
(2)  Understand trigonometric ratios and the arc method, and solve trigonometric equations correctly.
(3)  Understand trigonometric functions and draw trigonometric functions correctly.
(4)  Understand the concepts of differentiation and integration, and correctly obtain derivatives and integrals.
(5)  Draw fundamental functions, average rate of change, etc., correctly with Excel.
(6) Understand the mathematical questions in English correctly.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)  Understand the exponential and logarithmic laws and draw the outline of graphs of their functions.
(2)  Understand the trigonometric ratios and the arc method, and obtain trigonometric ratio values.
(3)  Understand trigonometric functions and draw outlines of trigonometric graphs.
(4)  Produce derivatives of polynomials, indefinite integrals, and definite integrals.
(5)  Draw outlines of fundamental functions, and average rate of change,etc., with Excel.
(6) Understand the mathematical questions in English generally.
